title: Calendar with no end-date field: the week/day "Resize start" handle still moves the event, and the calendar-view renderer drops endEditable
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #29020 (PR #29146; report `/mnt/project-files/issue-29020/os-dev-report.json`) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** A calendar view whose object has no end-date field shows each event as a point in time. After #29020, such a view no longer offers resizing the end. Two doors are still left open:
- In week and day views, the top "Resize start" handle writes a real start change and redraws the event one hour long, so dragging it reads as a move.
- A calendar authored as a page node goes through `calendar-view-renderer`, which does not forward the new `endEditable` prop, so it keeps the end handles #29020 removes.

**Measured (the #29020 dev, by reading and in tests at PR #29146 head `88ee38a1`; not run live).**
- With no end field, the time-grid top handle stays. Dragging it changes `start`, and the event redraws 1 h long.
- `calendar-view-renderer` passes no `endEditable` to `CalendarView`, so authored nodes get the default `true`.

**Wanted.**
1. With no end-date field, week and day views draw no resize handle at all. Moving the event stays a drag of its body.
2. The renderer forwards `endEditable` (or derives it from the node's end field) so that authored calendar nodes match `ObjectCalendar`.
3. Views with an end field are unchanged. No new metadata key.

**Tests.** No end field: no top handle in week and day views, and an authored node with no end field draws no end handles. With an end field, both handles stay.

**Reader.** `domain:ui` (`area:records`). Size S. Serialize after PR #29146 (#29020).

**Dedupe.** Searched `calendar resize start handle`, `endEditable renderer`: only #29020.

Links back: #29020, PR #29146.
